description: This file 'api.js' serves as a stub API client for a humanoid robot project. It contains mock functions for face recognition, emotion detection, natural language processing, and audio upload, intended to be replaced with real backend calls in the future.

methods.name: identifyFace(imageData)
methods.description: Simulates sending an image to a face recognition service and returns a mock identity response.

methods.name: detectEmotion(imageData)
methods.description: Simulates sending an image to an emotion detection service and returns a mock emotion response.

methods.name: nlpRespond(text, context = {})
methods.description: Simulates sending text to an NLP/chatbot service and returns a mock response.

methods.name: uploadAudio(audioBlob)
methods.description: Simulates uploading audio data for server-side transcription.

calls: console.log('[API] uploadAudio called with blob size:', audioBlob.size)
